Agenda
Item 1
Succession Planning Report — Kincaid Walsh Partners Executive Team

The Succession Planning Report — Kincaid Walsh Partners Executive Team was a review of the company's compliance with copyright laws. The committee reviewed the company's content portfolio and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To approve for profitability: RESOLVED, that the Board Strategy Offsite Planning Committee defers consideration of the Succession Planning Report — Kincaid Walsh Partners Executive Team to the next scheduled meeting, pending receipt of additional analysis from the responsible owner.

Moved: Abebe Gitau  •  Seconded: Georg Graves
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary

Tanvi Dizon led the discussion on the Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary, highlighting the recent performance data for the Video Streaming Services sector. The committee noted the 11% deviation from the forecast and debated potential corrective measures. The consensus was to adopt a phased approach, as outlined in the revised proposal. A formal vote followed.

Motion

To amend: RESOLVED, that the Board Strategy Offsite Planning Committee approves the public disclosure of the Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary in the company's upcoming proxy statement.

Moved: Abebe Gitau  •  Seconded: Pallavi Ngo
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Data Privacy Impact Assessment (DPIA) Report

The {item_title} was presented by {presenter}, who outlined the proposed changes to the company's compensation philosophy. The committee debated the merits of moving to a more aggressive market positioning and ultimately approved a shift to the 75th percentile for critical roles.

Motion

To approve for talent attraction: RESOLVED, that the Board Strategy Offsite Planning Committee hereby approves the Data Privacy Impact Assessment (DPIA) Report as presented, effective 2010-12-14, and authorizes the designated owner to take all actions necessary to implement the foregoing.

Moved: Oluwakemi Dutta  •  Seconded: Georg Graves
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
